node.statement: Theorems 6.4-6.5 + Remarks 7.1-7.2: Vector propagator ⟨V_iV_j⟩ = P^T_{ij}/(k²p²). Tensor propagator ⟨h^{TT}_{ij}h^{TT}_{kl}⟩ = 2Π^{TT}_{ijkl}/p⁴. The 1/p⁴ poles are the hallmark of fourth-derivative gravity (massless graviton + Weyl ghost). At β=1/3, det(M)=0 (conformal gravity). At β=1/2, the scalar sector reduces to one constrained DOF. [Depends: 1.5, 1.6]
